title: Chapter 162: The First Expedition
content:
Chapter 162: The First Expedition

Nagalong will return to the tribe tomorrow to report. Wu Qing thought about it and felt that there was no time to lose, so he said that he would send a reinforcement to accompany him tomorrow to find the way first.

Later, according to the situation on the front line and the strength of its own troops, more reinforcements will be sent to participate in the war!

Wu Qing and Nagalong discussed many details, and Nagalong left happily.

Wu Qing looked at Nagalong's back as he left, and he was in a good mood. He had made another big deal.

The two people who came first finally talked about business. Gong Zhe, who had not come yet, was a businessman, and he must have talked about business.

This made people sigh that the most talked about thing in this world is still business!

…

Gong Zhe came over not long after Nagalong left, and he and Wu Qing continued to discuss the previous topic.

Gong Zhe had already determined in his heart that Wu Qing would be the boss of this area in the future. If the Goblin Chamber of Commerce wanted to develop smoothly here, it must first obtain Wu Qing's support.

There are also Zerg energy coins that the goblins urgently need. He must find a way to get the exclusive exchange rights.

Wu Qing felt that he had underestimated the role of Zerg energy coins through the goblins' emphasis on Zerg energy coins and his deepening understanding of this world.

His idea of promoting Zerg energy coins directly as currency was too hasty.

Wu Cong can take out a secret method of breeding war horses. With Zerg energy coins, you can breed super-high-quality war horses.

In this world, I don't know how many things are waiting for Zerg energy coins to transform.

A large number of Zerg energy coins are circulated, and the changes brought to this world cannot be controlled by Wu Qing, and may backfire on himself.

For things that cannot be controlled, you can't do it.

As for the promotion plan of Zerg currency, Wu Qing plans to redesign an energy coin with the Queen of Zerg. The energy purity contained in it only needs to be slightly better than the energy coins on the market. This will be conducive to promotion and will not affect itself.

The current high-purity Zerg energy coins can only be controlled as strategic materials.

With the "Zerg Overlord" taking care of everything, Wu Qing had nothing to worry about.

With this idea, Wu Qing was much more conservative when discussing the Zerg Energy Coin with Gong Zhe. He said that the Zerg Energy Coins granted by the Zerg Overlord were limited. In addition to the ones for personal use, they would be used to trade with the Goblin Chamber of Commerce as long as the Goblin Chamber of Commerce did not deliberately lower the price.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce needed Zerg Energy Coins, and Wu Qing needed the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. Both parties were protected by powerful people. This kind of interest binding was the most reliable relationship.

The two chatted until Meng and Hu Wei and other alliance lords came to Wu Qing. Everyone was very happy today, so they held a dinner under Meng's arrangement. Meng was very generous about food and drink.

Wu Qing asked someone to invite Nagalong and introduced him to the alliance lords. Nagalong, who was straightforward, soon became friends with Meng and several other lords.

...

As night was about to fall, a large number of Zerg troops withdrew back to the Zerg territory.

Wu Qing only left Zerg puppies in Guangfu City, and almost all other Zerg troops withdrew to the Zerg territory. In the newly occupied small strongholds, except for the evil god believers who became parasites, some Zerg puppies were left for reconnaissance.

These strongholds will be the bases for Zerg puppies to go out for reconnaissance in the future.

The main force of the Zerg was withdrawn to the Zerg territory to guard against possible attacks on the Zerg underground territory.

It is said that it is better to be prepared than to be caught unprepared. It is possible that the mysterious enemy will come out and cause trouble the next day, so we have to be on guard.

In the end, the Zerg, who were on high alert, did nothing. That night, the Zerg territory was very quiet and nothing happened.

…

At dawn the next day, Wu Qing assembled 200,000 Zerg puppies in the Zerg territory, hatched 1,000 explosive mosquitoes, and upgraded another three-star host.

Wu Qing, the third three-star host, led 200,000 Zerg Zerglings and 1,000 Exploding Swarms to follow Nagalong on an expedition to the Naga territory.

Except for the three-star host, the Zerg Zerglings and Exploding Swarms that went on the expedition were all expendable troops of the Zerg, and they had no intention of coming back after they were sent out.

In Guangfu City, Gou Yin left with Gou Bao and the Tengu cavalry early in the morning. Gong Zhe also said goodbye and left because he needed to establish a chamber of commerce as soon as possible and had a lot of things to do. Only the Naga team had not set off yet.

Wu Qing's plan to send troops to support the Naga tribe had just been confirmed and had not been officially announced. Even the lords of the alliance were unaware of it, and it was even more impossible for the Tengu tribe and Gong Zhe to know, otherwise they would definitely not have left so early.

Wu Qing did not need to hide the Zerg's sending troops to support the Naga tribe. Things that were beneficial to his reputation should be publicized more.

It is not too late to publicize it now because it is not too late to wait until the first batch of Zerg reinforcements arrive at the Naga tribe and officially confirm the relevant matters of cooperation with the Naga tribe.

When the Zerg army arrived at Guangfu City from the Zerg territory, Wu Qing informed Nagalong and the lords of the alliance.

Nagalong led the Naga warriors out of the city. When he saw the endless Zerg puppies army in front of him and more than a thousand strange Zerg flying in the air, he excitedly shouted to the Naga warriors: "This is the first batch of Zerg warriors supporting our tribe!"

"Our mission is successfully completed!"

Nagalong swam to Wu Qing and bowed again in gratitude: "Thank you! Respected Lord!"

All Naga warriors also looked at Wu Qing with respect, and they were full of goodwill towards this seemingly gentle human lord.

At this time, Wu Qing sent troops to help, which was like sending charcoal in the snow. No matter what purpose was behind it, they were worthy of gratitude.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Wu Qing called the three-star host floating in the air like a small house and said to Nagalong: "This is the Zerg host that represents me to go to war. You can call it No. 3!"

"No. 3 represents me. It has obtained my full authorization. Its decision is my decision. You can discuss subsequent related matters with it!"

Wu Qing can possess the Zerg host at any time. All Zergs are alternative avatars of Wu Qing and the Queen. The three-star host has a huge spiritual power and amazing abilities. It can be used as Wu Qing's substitute and go to the Naga tribe alone.

The title of No. 3 means that it is the third three-star host. Zerg does not need to have a formal name.

Wu Qing also told Nagalong some special places of the Zerg, such as logistics support. Wu Qing explained that the Zerg will bring enough energy coins and can meet the body's consumption by absorbing energy, without the need for ordinary logistics supplies.

As long as the Naga tribe knows how to do things, they will definitely compensate for this part, and the Zerg will save the trouble of dealing with the Naga tribe for supplies and can concentrate on fighting.

There are some other things like this, Wu Qing explained them to Nagalong one by one, and Nagalong listened carefully and nodded continuously.

The lords of the Menghe Alliance also received Wu Qing's notice not long ago, knowing that the Zerg tribe would send troops to support the Naga tribe alone, and further saw the strength of the Zerg tribe. Everyone is happy to see the Zerg go out.

When the Zerg led the alliance army to counterattack, they still had the strength to provide external support. This strength makes everyone feel at ease.

"Listen to what Nagalong just said, this is only the first batch of Zerg reinforcements, there will definitely be more support later!"

"The Zerg is going to speed up its entry into the world. If we don't work hard to develop these small territories of the Alliance, we will not be able to keep up with the Alliance!"

"Don't worry, after all, we are also the first batch of veterans of the Alliance. It's worth it to have this identity! Haha!"

"..."

The lords of the Alliance also felt the pressure from the rapid improvement of the Zerg's strength.

...

After Wu Qing explained to Nagalong, he watched Nagalong lead the Naga warriors to lead the way, with more than 200,000 Zerg reinforcements, all the way north, to the Naga's sphere of influence.

With the current relatively balanced combat situation between the Naga and the evil god camp, with the Zerg reinforcements, the balance of victory and defeat in the camp war may be broken.

For Nagalong, it is meaningful to rush back one minute earlier.

As for the marching speed, No. 3 has already told him that the faster the Naga warriors can run, the faster the Zerg can run, and the longer the Naga warriors can run.

The Zerg hive has been upgraded by two stars, and the Zerg puppies have also been fully strengthened twice, and have been strengthened in terms of offensive ability, defensive ability, offensive speed and movement speed.

It can be said that the combat power of the Zerg puppies is now far beyond the past, and it is the combat power ceiling of creatures below one star in this world.

If it were not for the restrictions of the rules of this world, their strength would be enough to enter the one star level.

As the hive continues to upgrade, the combat power of the Zerg puppies continues to increase, and perhaps it will break some common sense in this world.

The one-star Naga warriors led by Nagalong roamed at full speed, and the Zerg puppies could easily keep up, not to mention the explosive mosquitoes flying in the air and the three-star hosts.

The Naga warriors may feel that they have lost the face of their one-star strength, and began to rush on the road at full speed, roaming like flying!

Two hundred thousand Zerg puppies followed behind, running like the wind, with amazing momentum!

Wherever they passed, birds and beasts were terrified!

Without the burden of the logistics troops, the marching speed was fast!

Marching at this speed, it didn't take long for them to leave the area controlled by the Zerg and enter a completely unfamiliar area.

"Leader No. 3, the war zone is ahead! The Tengu tribe can no longer control these territories, and the army of the evil god camp will appear!"

"In order to get back earlier, we won't take a detour, just rush over!"

"With our strength, it won't be a problem to rush over!"

Nagalong shouted to No. 3 flying near him, reminding the Zerg that they had entered the war zone.

"Keep going at full speed, ordinary enemies can't stop us!"

Host No. 3 made a sound by vibrating the air.

"Okay! Then we will fight side by side! Kill all the way back!"

"Warriors of the Naga tribe! Get ready for battle!"

Nagalong shouted.

"Fight!"

"Fight!"

The Naga warriors shouted for battle with high morale!
